items.title: LLM Position Bias: Does Naming an Option First Change an AI's Answer?
items.author: ritzaco
items.snippet: Since the beginning of time, LLMs have always just agreed with their users. In a comparison where an LLM didn't know what to agree with, it would just choose the first-named option, assuming it was the first one that came to the user's mind for a reason. The reason is far less…
